coverage.budget: At most 20 free public consumer-evidence documents; no outreach or purchase.
coverage.examined: Four manufacturer listings; two additional cached consumer pages considered as counterevidence, not added independent users. US NYX and direct Reddit fetch failures recorded. #344 then completed one contrastive pass over ten attempted source URLs; full ledger is contrastive_pass.

consumer_counterevidence.summary: Search-indexed February 2023 report praises a thin Chanel formula and smaller applicator. Direct fetch failed; this is a weak counterexample cue requiring source confirmation, not measured low-dose adequacy.

Search-indexed December 2025 report says Chanel dispenses generously and recommends a light hand. Full review text was not retrieved; naming/translation and edition uncertain. This conflicts with inferring universal low-dose adequacy from favorable reports.

contrastive_pass.counting: Ten unique additional attempted source URLs, including failed/partial access; searches and repeated retrievals do not add documents. Each page and its comments count once. No additional corpus records or new people inferred.

sources.product: Chanel Le Rouge Duo Ultra Tenue; seven named shades, not separate participants

sources.provenance: Original author experience; affiliate links disclosed; generation and per-shade loading unknown.

contrastive_pass.stop_reason: Original consumer, manufacturer and component evidence still lacks matched no-removal adequacy. Stop this pass at ten documents; do not fill the quota with generic reviews or start another automatic search successor.

limitations: The requirement is coherent at behavior level but quantitative acceptance criteria and willingness to switch are unknown.
Different source-local authors are not proven globally distinct people.
These are listing-level identities; no cross-site SKU, shade or generation equivalence inferred.
Brand instructions and INCI are not dose-accuracy, wear-performance or safety evidence.
Other three provisionally qualified groups still lack complete alternatives and technical gates; ranking does not release them.
The ten additional URLs provide contrastive evidence, not ten independent users or an expanded frozen sample. Public authors are not linked across sites.
A satisfied user who accepts wiping, drying, gloss reapplication or a different finish does not prove the original no-removal goal is met. Unreported wiping is unknown, not evidence of its absence.
The component patent describes a possible mechanism without measured loading, commercial-SKU identification or product performance. It cannot release a new-product proposal.

decision.reason: After one ten-document contrastive pass, hold release on insufficient alternative evidence. Favorable alternatives exist and must be preserved, but their no-removal suitability for the frozen thin-layer goal is unmeasured. Observed Laka inconvenience survives as research evidence, not proof of a worldwide market gap. Stop additional automatic expansion; #184 and #325 remain held.
decision.falsifier: Set the operational acceptance goal, then obtain attributable matched use or loading evidence for current variants. A satisfactory existing alternative retires the premise. Source-linked reproducible residual failure across examined alternatives permits narrow technical review. A user may instead decide this requirement is not worth pursuing; that is a scope decision, not fabricated evidence.
missing_input: User decision: is removing applicator excess itself unacceptable, or is satisfactory wear after an ordinary application routine an acceptable solution? No preference is inferred from unrelated satisfied authors.
For the no-removal goal: exact available shade/package generation and an acceptable thin-film result, permissible wiping actions and acceptable wear/finish trade-offs for a comparative observation.
Matched repeated-use evidence on current Laka and actual alternative packages, including pickup before/after manual removal and thin-layer outcome. Public claims currently lack these measurements.

minimum_measurement.scope: Screen current Laka and one acceptable available alternative first; record shade, lot/package generation, fill state, mixing instructions and handling conditions. Ten repeated loadings per package is an exploratory screen, not a statistical performance or safety claim.
minimum_measurement.measure: With a verified-resolution balance, weigh applicator loaded versus clean/dry baseline under controlled withdrawal; record first/repeat loading, manual removal count and mass removed. Photograph a standardized thin-film application and record whether the chosen acceptance criterion is met. Include operator variability and evaporation limits.
minimum_measurement.limits: Balance resolution must be demonstrably smaller than the differences under study; choose mass thresholds only after the acceptance target is set. A bench coating does not establish human wear, safety or satisfaction. No concentration or formula inferred.
minimum_measurement.release: A suitable existing package retires the new-product premise. Contradictory matched evidence across examined alternatives can justify narrowly bounded technical assessment; unknowns keep release held.
